BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   C. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

8. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   C. Treat Money as rumours only.
   D. Say Money never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   C. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.

   C. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

16. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.

   D. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
